type.family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; local only

designRationale: A quiet civic reading surface with a dominant proposal and five equal vertical choices. Existing ballot-box identity and local type remain; no competition, clock, opinion-correctness signals, party palettes or analytical entry form.
briefReview: Retained existing blue-grey/ink palette and ballot identity; removed competing programme-comparison actions and priority setup from the intro. Large proposal typography carries identity, while results lead with concrete relationships rather than a winner.

visualReview.findingResolved: Prototype validation state initially retained an earlier selected option; it now clears the selection in the missing-answer specimen.
observations: All five opinion options have the same size and appearance before selection.
Selected radio, border and background provide redundant feedback.
Help remains optional and does not predict policy consequences.
A high fictitious aggregate result still labels the rent disagreement separately.
Missing programme candidacy remains visible and unscored.

limitations: This is a local fixture prototype, not the released 2023 bank or complete application.
Actual full-length directly authored questions and help must be reviewed after corpus reading/cross-reference.
Scope specimen shows three provinces only; the application still needs all52 local registry options.
Prototype state switching does not implement adaptive selection or actual scores.
Q017 remains in progress; Q018-Q024 application integration and real-copy acceptance remain pending.
